metadata.question: Does the surface soil moisture in Utah decrease in August 2020, compare to long-term records for the same month?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need soil moisture data for Utah - Compare August 2020 vs. long-term August average - NASA SMAP or ERA5-Land are good options for soil moisture - ERA5-Land has longer historical record (1950-present), better for long-term comparison - Use 'volumetric_soil_water_layer_1' (0-7cm surface layer) 2. Masking strategy: - Soil moisture data doesn't need cloud masking - Focus on valid data pixels only 3. Logic: - Calculate mean soil moisture for August 2020 in Utah - Calculate long-term mean for August (e.g., 1981-2010 or available historical period) - Compare: if 2020 < long-term average, then YES (decrease) - Valid Zero: Soil moisture should be 0-1 (m³/m³), if outside range or None → C3 - If no data → C1, if no valid pixels → C2 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Utah geometry const utah = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Utah')) .geometry(); // 2. Load ERA5-Land soil moisture data const era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY'); const band = 'volumetric_soil_water_layer_1'; // 3. August 2020 data const aug2020 = era5 .filterDate('2020-08-01', '2020-09-01') .select(band); const size2020 = aug2020.size().getInfo(); console.log('August 2020 images:', size2020); if (size2020 === 0) { console.log('No data for August 2020'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Long-term August average (1981-2019) const longTerm = era5 .filterDate('1981-08-01', '2019-09-01') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month')) .select(band); const sizeLongTerm = longTerm.size().getInfo(); console.log('Long-term August images:', sizeLongTerm); if (sizeLongTerm === 0) { console.log('No long-term data available'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Calculate means const mean2020Image = aug2020.mean(); const meanLongTermImage = longTerm.mean(); // 6. Reduce over Utah const stats2020 = mean2020Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: utah, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const statsLongTerm = meanLongTermImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: utah, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const val2020 = stats2020[band + '_mean']; const count2020 = stats2020[band + '_count']; const valLongTerm = statsLongTerm[band + '_mean']; const countLongTerm = statsLongTerm[band + '_count']; console.log('August 2020 - Mean:', val2020, 'Pixels:', count2020); console.log('Long-term August - Mean:', valLongTerm, 'Pixels:', countLongTerm); // 7. Validation if (count2020 === 0 || countLongTerm === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (val2020 === null || val2020 === undefined || isNaN(val2020) || valLongTerm === null || valLongTerm === undefined || isNaN(valLongTerm)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid values'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (val2020 < 0 || val2020 > 1 || valLongTerm < 0 || valLongTerm > 1) { console.log('Invalid soil moisture range'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 8. Final comparison const difference = val2020 - valLongTerm; const percentChange = ((val2020 - valLongTerm) / valLongTerm * 100).toFixed(2); console.log('Difference:', difference.toFixed(4), 'm³/m³'); console.log('Percent change:', percentChange + '%'); if (val2020 < valLongTerm) { console.log('August 2020 shows DECREASED soil moisture vs long-term'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('August 2020 shows NO DECREASE in soil moisture vs long-term'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
